chunks.text:
[Intro - storyteller speaks, then sings]
{a female voice speaks, low and close} Mukashi, mukashi...
(ARU TOKORO NI!)
[Verse 1 - the storyteller sings every line]
Once upon a time there was a crab, and her mother, and a line:
"Walk straight," said the mother. "Why d'you scuttle side to side?
Straight, like everybody else does." And the little one looked up, and said—
I know this part. I've read it in forty tongues.
Every telling ends on the same page. Nobody ever shows. Nobody ever can.
The little one looked up, and said:
positive_styles: FEMALE VOCALIST SINGS EVERY LINE, vocals clearly audible from the first bar
low contralto storyteller voice, warm, dry, close-mic, straight tone
two hyoshigi wooden clacks at the start
